Trump gas — like Trump shoes, Trump cologne, the Trump Bible, Trump NFTs, Trump crypto, Trump resorts, Trump University, and everything else he’s tried to sell as a good deal — is turning out to be a ripoff. https://robertreich.substack.com/p/trump-gas

For nearly a half century, trickle-down economic policies have resulted in a tax system rigged in favor of the rich. This is not only bad for our economy, but it’s leading to a billionaire takeover of our democracy as well. Watch. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wkiO0_uSJAk

Bannon referred to Orban as "Trump before Trump." 

Well, Orban is gone. MAGA is next.

Victor Orbán’s removal sends a timely signal.

Corrupt kleptocratic Christian nationalism was on the ballot in Hungary today — just as it will be on the ballots that Americans will cast in November. 

It was repudiated abroad — may it be repudiated here in November (and beyond).
What do you call a system where CEOs make millions of dollars while laying off thousands of workers?

Remember: The recipe for economic growth isn’t tax cuts for the rich. It’s investment in our people — in health care, infrastructure and education — to build a strong middle class. 

You don't grow the economy through trickle-down nonsense.

We have a president who took the nation into a war for reasons he cannot fully articulate, without a strategy for how to respond if Iran did the expected and closed the Strait of Hormuz, and without an exit strategy if Iran doesn’t surrender.

Reminder that Congress can step up and stop this.
There is one force more powerful than Trump. My friend Amy Goodman explains.
The past terrifying week has caused me to wonder: How the hell did we get here? And how do we change course? Some thoughts... https://robertreich.substack.com/p/sunday-thought-how-the-hell-did-we
The ultra-wealthy can’t cheat death, but they can use death to cheat taxes. Let me explain.

Remember: The oligarchs who control our economy and democracy seek to divide us so they can become more powerful.

They want us to turn on each other so we don't look up and see where all the wealth and power have gone.

Don't fall for it.

California’s billionaires are wealthier than they’ve ever been.

Meanwhile, millions of poor and working-class Californians are struggling to make ends' meet.

It's time to tax the rich. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bUcgiqsU6NQ

Tax cuts for giant corporations and the super rich. 

Paid for by cuts to the social safety net for everyone else. 

The state of Trump's union. [@itep.org]
Our full conversation: www.youtube.com/watch?v=yEbd...
Trump's Iran War is going so badly, even MAGA diehards are turning on him.

Trump is a genocidal maniac, and the American people (including some in the MAGA world) have had enough.

But where do we go from here? Is there even a ceasefire in the Middle East? What will be the long-term fallout?

We discuss these important questions on the latest Coffee Klatch.
Here's How To Counter Trump's $10 Billion Lawsuit Against the IRS https://robertreich.substack.com/p/how-to-counter-trumps-10-billion

Trump isn't just suing the IRS. He's waging a war on it. 

His regime has...

-Shut down the IRS's Direct File program, a huge gift to the tax prep industry

-Gutted IRS staff, leaving fewer employees to assist taxpayers

-Deprioritized federal tax prosecutions, letting tax cheats off the hook

This flew under the radar: Trump's new acting AG Todd Blanche shut down major DOJ investigations into crypto companies, dealers, and exchanges as Pam Bondi's second-in-command — all while holding at least $159,000 in crypto assets himself.

The fox is guarding the hen house.

The $117 billion tax break Trump handed the 1% is more than federal spending on:

-The Agriculture Department at $89.2 billion
-The Education Department at $46.9 billion
-The Labor Department at $22.7 billion
-The Energy Department at $20 billion

The rich are getting richer by robbing us.
What do you call a system where CEOs make millions of dollars while laying off thousands of workers?
There is one force more powerful than Trump. My friend Amy Goodman explains.
Trump's Iran War is going so badly, even MAGA diehards are turning on him.
I've said it before and I'll say it again: trickle-down economics is a cruel joke.

@rokhannausa is absolutely right. When the President of the United States threatens genocide against millions of innocent people, Democratic leadership should stand in clear moral opposition — not hide behind procedure.

It’s never been more clear that Donald Trump has completely lost his mind. It’s our responsibility to call on Congress, the military, and any sane individual in this administration to stop him from committing war crimes against the Iranian people.

Billionaires are crying foul about California's proposed wealth tax. Don't fall for their fearmongering. A one-time, 5% tax on their excessive wealth is essential to funding what millions of Californians need — and to preserving our democracy.

Why does the American tax system favor the wealthy? And how did it get this way? I chatted with Jon Stewart about this back in 2012. Sadly it's only gotten worse since then. We must keep up the fight to fix the system.

Huge election wins in Florida (and another on the horizon in Wisconsin). Raising taxes on the rich in Washington. Paid family and medical leave in Virginia. Even in these Trump times, there's good news to be found.
American workers face an existential threat not only from AI, but unprecedented levels of corporate greed. Trump doesn't seem to care.
